explication: GoPay is a Go SDK for integrating with multiple payment providers. A consuming application calls a provider SDK, which handles provider-specific requests and returns responses; Apple’s offering also covers payment verification. The README documents the supported providers and versions. Sampled client code shows several integrations using the shared HTTP client, but most API-method internals were not sampled, so provider-level flows are documented at the SDK boundary rather than expanded into speculative domain stages.
